definition: A group of deep neck muscles located beneath the occipital bone at the base of the skull, responsible for fine movements of the head and neck. These muscles are important for proprioception and stabilizing the upper cervical spine.
translation: 枕下肌群；位於頭骨枕部下方的深層頸部肌肉，負責頭頸部的精細運動
example: Physical therapists often focus on releasing tension in the suboccipitals to relieve headaches and neck pain.
